hypothesis.name: Anderson-PINN multi-physics: B=2 catalogue-flank pruned d28 base + Anderson-consistent geothermal conduit & step-over dots
hypothesis.statement: Pruning mechanically impossible E-W strikes (parallel to sigma_3 ~105° extension) and reallocating the dot budget to GDR-1391 blind geothermal conduits plus geodetic step-over dilatation, under Raissi et al. (2019) structure-tensor orientation regularization, raises off-catalogue DTI over the h33-2-b2 base.

mechanism: DTI = TP_w / (0.2|P| + 0.8|G| + 0.8(TP_g - TP_p)); alpha=0.2 makes every extra dot a denominator tax, so redundant/continuos-line dots are thinned to ~300 m Poisson-disk spacing. Dots within 200 m of known catalogue faults are masked in scoring, so they pay pure FP tax: the B=2 (200 m) catalogue-flank exclusion removes them. The added dots target off-catalogue geothermal upflow conduits (GDR 1391, T>=130 C, >1.5 km off catalogue) and geodetic step-over dilatation, gated by Anderson-consistent strike (NNE-SSW normal / NW-SE transtensional; E-W strikes parallel to sigma_3 suppressed).
named_non_fault_mimic_process: E-W geophysical lineaments from flight-line noise, lithologic contacts, and drainage channels mimic fault strikes; radiometric clay-alteration halos, spring/vent density, and broad magnetic or gravity anomaly bodies can mimic geothermal conduits without an underlying fault.
